value.rationale: A natural identification problem on the smallest cubic biaffine Levi graph has a complete exact minimum-configuration classification and concrete transformation consequences: six small isolated exchange families, one connected 486-base family with sharp diameter five, and universal one-edge-slide immobility. These features are not implied by the edge metric dimension alone or by ordinary incidence-graph metric dimension, and the geometric incidence condition explains why basis mobility is restricted.
